<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<IATA_AirShoppingRQ xmlns="http://www.iata.org/IATA/2015/EASD/00/IATA_OffersAndOrdersMessage" 
                     xmlns:cns="http://www.iata.org/IATA/2015/EASD/00/IATA_OffersAndOrdersCommonTypes">
    <!-- Distribution Chain -->
    <DistributionChain>
        <cns:DistributionChainLink>
            <cns:Ordinal>1</cns:Ordinal>
            <cns:OrgRole>Seller</cns:OrgRole>
            <cns:ParticipatingOrg>
                <cns:Name>Travel Agency XYZ</cns:Name>
                <cns:OrgID>SELLER123</cns:OrgID>
            </cns:ParticipatingOrg>
        </cns:DistributionChainLink>
    </DistributionChain>
    <!-- Payload Attributes -->
    <!-- optional -->
    <PayloadAttributes>
        <cns:CorrelationID>{{$randomUUID}}</cns:CorrelationID>
        <cns:Timestamp>{{today_th}}</cns:Timestamp>
        <cns:TrxID>TRX-123456789</cns:TrxID>
        <cns:VersionNumber>21.3</cns:VersionNumber>
    </PayloadAttributes>
    <!-- Request -->
    <Request>
        <!-- Flight Request -->
        <cns:FlightRequest>
            <cns:FlightRequestOriginDestinationsCriteria>
                <!-- KRP to CPH -->
                <cns:OriginDestCriteria>
                    <cns:DestArrivalCriteria>
                        <cns:Date>{{arrivalDate}}</cns:Date>
                        <cns:IATA_LocationCode>{{arrivalCode}}</cns:IATA_LocationCode>
                    </cns:DestArrivalCriteria>
                    <cns:OriginDepCriteria>
                        <cns:Date>{{departureDate}}</cns:Date>
                        <cns:IATA_LocationCode>{{departureCode}}</cns:IATA_LocationCode>
                    </cns:OriginDepCriteria>
                </cns:OriginDestCriteria>
            </cns:FlightRequestOriginDestinationsCriteria>
        </cns:FlightRequest>
        <!-- Passenger List -->
        <cns:PaxList>
            <cns:Pax>
                <cns:PaxID>PAX1</cns:PaxID>
                <cns:PTC>ADT</cns:PTC>
            </cns:Pax>
            <cns:Pax>
                <cns:PaxID>PAX2</cns:PaxID>
                <cns:PTC>CHD</cns:PTC>
            </cns:Pax>
            <cns:Pax>
                <cns:PaxID>PAX3</cns:PaxID>
                <cns:PTC>INF</cns:PTC>
            </cns:Pax>
        </cns:PaxList>
    </Request>
</IATA_AirShoppingRQ>

<IATA_AirShoppingRQ xmlns="http://www.iata.org/IATA/2015/EASD/00/IATA_OffersAndOrdersMessage" 
                     xmlns:cns="http://www.iata.org/IATA/2015/EASD/00/IATA_OffersAndOrdersCommonTypes">
    
    <!-- Distribution Chain -->
    <DistributionChain>
        <cns:DistributionChainLink>
            <cns:Ordinal>1</cns:Ordinal>
            <cns:OrgRole>Seller</cns:OrgRole>
            <cns:ParticipatingOrg>
                <cns:Name>Travel Agency XYZ</cns:Name>
                <cns:OrgID>SELLER123</cns:OrgID>
            </cns:ParticipatingOrg>
        </cns:DistributionChainLink>
    </DistributionChain>
    
    <!-- Payload Attributes -->
    <!-- optional -->
    <PayloadAttributes>
        <cns:CorrelationID>{{$randomUUID}}</cns:CorrelationID>
        <cns:Timestamp>{{today_th}}</cns:Timestamp>
        <cns:TrxID>TRX-123456789</cns:TrxID>
        <cns:VersionNumber>21.3</cns:VersionNumber>
    </PayloadAttributes>

    <!-- Request -->
    <Request>
        <!-- Flight Request -->
        <cns:FlightRequest>
            <cns:FlightRequestOriginDestinationsCriteria>
                <cns:OriginDestCriteria>
                    <cns:DestArrivalCriteria>
                        <cns:Date>{{arrivalDate}}</cns:Date>
                        <cns:IATA_LocationCode>{{arrivalCode}}</cns:IATA_LocationCode>
                    </cns:DestArrivalCriteria>
                    <cns:OriginDepCriteria>
                        <cns:Date>{{departureDate}}</cns:Date>
                        <cns:IATA_LocationCode>{{departureCode}}</cns:IATA_LocationCode>
                    </cns:OriginDepCriteria>
                </cns:OriginDestCriteria>
                <cns:OriginDestCriteria>
                    <cns:DestArrivalCriteria>
                        <cns:Date>{{nextArrivalDate}}</cns:Date>
                        <cns:IATA_LocationCode>{{departureCode}}</cns:IATA_LocationCode>
                    </cns:DestArrivalCriteria>
                    <cns:OriginDepCriteria>
                        <cns:Date>{{nextDepartureDate}}</cns:Date>
                        <cns:IATA_LocationCode>{{arrivalCode}}</cns:IATA_LocationCode>
                    </cns:OriginDepCriteria>
                </cns:OriginDestCriteria>
            </cns:FlightRequestOriginDestinationsCriteria>
        </cns:FlightRequest>
        
        <!-- Passenger List -->
        <cns:PaxList>
            <cns:Pax>
                <cns:PaxID>PAX1</cns:PaxID>
                <cns:PTC>ADT</cns:PTC>
            </cns:Pax>
            <cns:Pax>
                <cns:PaxID>PAX2</cns:PaxID>
                <cns:PTC>CHD</cns:PTC>
            </cns:Pax>

                        </cns:SelectedSeat>
                    </cns:SelectedOfferItem>
                </cns:SelectedOffer>
            </cns:SelectedOfferList>
        </cns:PricedOffer>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<IATA_AirShoppingRQ xmlns="http://www.iata.org/IATA/2015/EASD/00/IATA_OffersAndOrdersMessage"
                     xmlns:cns="http://www.iata.org/IATA/2015/EASD/00/IATA_OffersAndOrdersCommonTypes">
    <DistributionChain>
        <cns:DistributionChainLink>
            <cns:Ordinal>1</cns:Ordinal>
            <cns:OrgRole>Seller</cns:OrgRole>
            <cns:ParticipatingOrg>
                <cns:Name>Travel Agency XYZ</cns:Name>
                <cns:OrgID>SELLER123</cns:OrgID>
            </cns:ParticipatingOrg>
        </cns:DistributionChainLink>
    </DistributionChain>
    <PayloadAttributes>
        <cns:CorrelationID>{{$randomUUID}}</cns:CorrelationID>
        <cns:Timestamp>{{today_th}}</cns:Timestamp>
        <cns:TrxID>TRX-123456789</cns:TrxID>
        <cns:VersionNumber>21.3</cns:VersionNumber>
    </PayloadAttributes>
    <Request>
        <!-- VI route: {{departureCode}} -> {{arrivalCode}} is sold as ONE itinerary stitched from two carriers.
             Dates are computed by the folder pre-request: today + daysToDeparture (return: today + daysToReturn). -->
        <cns:FlightRequest>
            <cns:FlightRequestOriginDestinationsCriteria>
                <cns:OriginDestCriteria>
                    <cns:DestArrivalCriteria>
                        <cns:Date>{{arrivalDate}}</cns:Date>
                        <cns:IATA_LocationCode>{{arrivalCode}}</cns:IATA_LocationCode>
                    </cns:DestArrivalCriteria>
                    <cns:OriginDepCriteria>
                        <cns:Date>{{departureDate}}</cns:Date>
                        <cns:IATA_LocationCode>{{departureCode}}</cns:IATA_LocationCode>
                    </cns:OriginDepCriteria>
                </cns:OriginDestCriteria>
            </cns:FlightRequestOriginDestinationsCriteria>
        </cns:FlightRequest>
        <cns:PaxList>
            <cns:Pax>
                <cns:PaxID>PAX1</cns:PaxID>
                <cns:PTC>ADT</cns:PTC>
            </cns:Pax>
            <cns:Pax>
                <cns:PaxID>PAX2</cns:PaxID>
                <cns:PTC>CHD</cns:PTC>
            </cns:Pax>
            <cns:Pax>
                <cns:PaxID>PAX3</cns:PaxID>
                <cns:PTC>INF</cns:PTC>
            </cns:Pax>
        </cns:PaxList>
    </Request>
</IATA_AirShoppingRQ>

if (MUST_MATCH_ORDER_ID) pm.test('the order asked for is the order returned', () => pm.expect(text(order.OrderID)).to.equal(pm.environment.get('orderId')));
// Two statuses per item: OrderItem/StatusCode (ACTIVE once booked) and Service/StatusCode (REQUESTED -> CONFIRMED once paid).

return { id: text(it.OrderItemID), pax: text(svc.PaxRefID), pnr: text(svc.BookingRef && svc.BookingRef.BookingID), status: text(it.StatusCode), serviceStatus: text(svc.StatusCode), service: !!assoc.ServiceDefinitionRef, owner: text(it.OwnerCode) };
pm.test('order total with currency present', () => { pm.expect(text(total), 'TotalAmount').to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(curOf(total), 'CurCode').to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });
if (EXPECT_MIN_ITEMS > 0) pm.test('order carries every selected item (' + EXPECT_MIN_ITEMS + ')', () => pm.expect(items.length).to.be.at.least(EXPECT_MIN_ITEMS));
pm.test('booking reference (PNR) present', () => pm.expect(pnrs.length, 'no Service/BookingRef/BookingID on any order item').to.be.above(0));
if (EXPECT_SERVICE_ITEM) pm.test('order contains the added service item', () => pm.expect(items.some(i => i.service), 'no order item with a ServiceDefinitionRef').to.be.true);

if (EXPECT_CONFIRMED_SERVICE_ITEM) pm.test('the added service item is CONFIRMED', () => pm.expect(items.filter(i => i.service).map(i => i.serviceStatus), 'Service/StatusCode of the service items').to.include('CONFIRMED'));
if (EXPECT_TICKETS) pm.test('ticket issued for every passenger', () => {
paxList.forEach(p => pm.expect(ticketedPax.has(text(p.PaxID)), 'no ticket for ' + text(p.PaxID) + ' (' + text(p.PTC) + ')').to.be.true);

pm.test('order total equals what was paid before (' + before + ') plus this payment (' + paid + ')', () => pm.expect(Number(text(total)), 'order total ' + text(total)).to.equal(Math.round((before + paid) * 100) / 100));
// Paid: forget the amount so that running [Pay] again is skipped instead of charging the order twice.
if (SET_PAYMENT && total) { pm.environment.set('paymentAmount', text(total)); pm.environment.set('paymentCurCode', curOf(total)); }

console.log('orderId =', text(order.OrderID), '| owner', text(order.OwnerCode), '| status', text(order.StatusCode), '| total', text(total), curOf(total), '| PNR', pnrs.join('/'), '| tickets', tickets.length);
items.forEach((i, n) => console.log('  orderItemId' + n, i.owner, i.pax, i.service ? 'service' : 'flight', i.status + '/' + i.serviceStatus, i.pnr, i.id));

    <POS>
        <ns2:Country>
            <ns2:CountryCode>FR</ns2:CountryCode>
        </ns2:Country>

        <ns2:Order>
            <ns2:OrderID>{{orderId}}</ns2:OrderID>
            <ns2:OwnerCode>{{orderOwnerCode}}</ns2:OwnerCode>

        <!-- Pays the pending purchase: {{paymentAmount}} is the order total that the OrderCreate [Pay Later] /
             OrderChange [ADD ...] response returned, and is cleared once paid (a second [Pay] is not sent).

        <ns2:PaymentFunctions>

                <ns2:PaymentMethod>
                    <ns2:OfflinePayment>
                        <ns2:PaymentTypeCode>CA</ns2:PaymentTypeCode>
                    </ns2:OfflinePayment>
                </ns2:PaymentMethod>
            </ns2:PaymentProcessingDetails>
        </ns2:PaymentFunctions>
    </Request>
</IATA_OrderChangeRQ>

item.description:
Shop -> price -> create an **on-hold** order -> retrieve -> quote -> pay by **cash**.

Expected: AirShopping returns VI offers for {{departureCode}} -> {{arrivalCode}}; OfferPrice prices all items of the chosen offer (OW 6 / RT 12); OrderCreate [Pay Later] returns an order with one PNR per carrier and a payment time limit; OrderQuote reports `NoChangeInd = true`; OrderChange [Pay] [CASH] returns the order with one ticket per passenger and carrier (6 ticket numbers for 1 ADT + 1 CHD + 1 INF).

Payment variants: cash only - debit account is not supported on VI, card payment requires a PCI-Proxy token.

// Reads IATA_OrderViewRS: order id and owner, items, booking references (one PNR per carrier on VI),
// ticket numbers and the total, and exports them for the next steps.
const CHECK_PAID_AMOUNT = true;          // this request paid {{paymentAmount}}: the order total must grow by exactly that
const SET_PAYMENT = false;                // the order now has a pending purchase: the next [Pay] request pays this total
const RECORD_PAID = false;                // the order was paid in this request: remember the total for the post-booking payment check
pm.test('OrderViewRS with an OrderID', () => { pm.expect(order, 'no Order in OrderViewRS').to.exist; pm.expect(text(order.OrderID)).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });
if (MUST_MATCH_ORDER_ID) pm.test('the order asked for is the order returned', () => pm.expect(text(order.OrderID)).to.equal(pm.environment.get('orderId')));
// Two statuses per item: OrderItem/StatusCode (ACTIVE once booked) and Service/StatusCode (REQUESTED -> CONFIRMED once paid).

return { id: text(it.OrderItemID), pax: text(svc.PaxRefID), pnr: text(svc.BookingRef && svc.BookingRef.BookingID), status: text(it.StatusCode), serviceStatus: text(svc.StatusCode), service: !!assoc.ServiceDefinitionRef, owner: text(it.OwnerCode) };
pm.test('order total with currency present', () => { pm.expect(text(total), 'TotalAmount').to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(curOf(total), 'CurCode').to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });
if (EXPECT_MIN_ITEMS > 0) pm.test('order carries every selected item (' + EXPECT_MIN_ITEMS + ')', () => pm.expect(items.length).to.be.at.least(EXPECT_MIN_ITEMS));
pm.test('booking reference (PNR) present', () => pm.expect(pnrs.length, 'no Service/BookingRef/BookingID on any order item').to.be.above(0));
if (EXPECT_SERVICE_ITEM) pm.test('order contains the added service item', () => pm.expect(items.some(i => i.service), 'no order item with a ServiceDefinitionRef').to.be.true);

if (EXPECT_CONFIRMED_SERVICE_ITEM) pm.test('the added service item is CONFIRMED', () => pm.expect(items.filter(i => i.service).map(i => i.serviceStatus), 'Service/StatusCode of the service items').to.include('CONFIRMED'));
if (EXPECT_TICKETS) pm.test('ticket issued for every passenger', () => {
paxList.forEach(p => pm.expect(ticketedPax.has(text(p.PaxID)), 'no ticket for ' + text(p.PaxID) + ' (' + text(p.PTC) + ')').to.be.true);

pm.test('order total equals what was paid before (' + before + ') plus this payment (' + paid + ')', () => pm.expect(Number(text(total)), 'order total ' + text(total)).to.equal(Math.round((before + paid) * 100) / 100));
// Paid: forget the amount so that running [Pay] again is skipped instead of charging the order twice.
if (SET_PAYMENT && total) { pm.environment.set('paymentAmount', text(total)); pm.environment.set('paymentCurCode', curOf(total)); }

console.log('orderId =', text(order.OrderID), '| owner', text(order.OwnerCode), '| status', text(order.StatusCode), '| total', text(total), curOf(total), '| PNR', pnrs.join('/'), '| tickets', tickets.length);
items.forEach((i, n) => console.log('  orderItemId' + n, i.owner, i.pax, i.service ? 'service' : 'flight', i.status + '/' + i.serviceStatus, i.pnr, i.id));

                <ns2:OrgID>Seller123</ns2:OrgID>
            </ns2:ParticipatingOrg>
        </ns2:DistributionChainLink>
    </DistributionChain>
    <PayloadAttributes>
        <ns2:CorrelationID>{{$randomUUID}}</ns2:CorrelationID>
        <ns2:Timestamp>{{today_th}}</ns2:Timestamp>

    </PayloadAttributes>
    <POS>
        <ns2:Country>
            <ns2:CountryCode>FR</ns2:CountryCode>
        </ns2:Country>
    </POS>
    <Request>
        <ns2:Order>
            <ns2:OrderID>{{orderId}}</ns2:OrderID>
            <ns2:OwnerCode>{{orderOwnerCode}}</ns2:OwnerCode>
        </ns2:Order>
        <!-- Pays the pending purchase: {{paymentAmount}} is the order total that the OrderCreate [Pay Later] /
             OrderChange [ADD ...] response returned, and is cleared once paid (a second [Pay] is not sent).
             Cash (CA) is the payment method supported on VI. Debit account is not supported on VI and a card
             payment needs a PCI-Proxy token (see Order Change -> payment in the partner guide). -->
        <ns2:PaymentFunctions>
            <ns2:PaymentProcessingDetails>
                <ns2:Amount CurCode="{{paymentCurCode}}">{{paymentAmount}}</ns2:Amount>
                <ns2:PaymentMethod>
                    <ns2:OfflinePayment>
                        <ns2:PaymentTypeCode>CA</ns2:PaymentTypeCode>
                    </ns2:OfflinePayment>
                </ns2:PaymentMethod>
            </ns2:PaymentProcessingDetails>
        </ns2:PaymentFunctions>
    </Request>
</IATA_OrderChangeRQ>

item.description:
Pre-booking **service** (SSR) on a new booking: shop -> ServiceList by offer -> OfferPrice (flight + service) -> OrderCreate [Pay Later] (flight + service) -> pay by cash -> retrieve.

ServiceList asks for the services of the leg chosen by `ancillaryLeg` (default 1 = the AeroCRS leg) **in the currency of the flight offer**; its test script picks one item for the adult by `serviceCode` (default XBAG).

Expected: ServiceList returns one ALaCarteOffer (on dev: CBBG, XBAG, AVIH, VGML, UMNR, WCHR, DSLB, in EUR); OfferPrice prices flight + service in one PricedOffer (6 + 1 items); OrderCreate [Pay Later] returns 7 order items; OrderChange [Pay] [CASH] returns one ticket per passenger and carrier.

Known limits (dev, 2026-10-06): services for the SMS leg (`ancillaryLeg` = 2) answer 422 / 911 `No segment attributes found for segment key ...`; asking ServiceList in another currency than the flight offer ends in `Currency mismatch: EUR/USD` at OfferPrice / OrderCreate.

<IATA_AirShoppingRQ xmlns="http://www.iata.org/IATA/2015/EASD/00/IATA_OffersAndOrdersMessage"
                     xmlns:cns="http://www.iata.org/IATA/2015/EASD/00/IATA_OffersAndOrdersCommonTypes">
    <DistributionChain>
        <cns:DistributionChainLink>
            <cns:Ordinal>1</cns:Ordinal>
            <cns:OrgRole>Seller</cns:OrgRole>
            <cns:ParticipatingOrg>
                <cns:Name>Travel Agency XYZ</cns:Name>
                <cns:OrgID>SELLER123</cns:OrgID>
            </cns:ParticipatingOrg>
        </cns:DistributionChainLink>
    </DistributionChain>
    <PayloadAttributes>
        <cns:CorrelationID>{{$randomUUID}}</cns:CorrelationID>
        <cns:Timestamp>{{today_th}}</cns:Timestamp>
        <cns:TrxID>TRX-123456789</cns:TrxID>
        <cns:VersionNumber>21.3</cns:VersionNumber>
    </PayloadAttributes>
    <Request>
        <!-- VI route: {{departureCode}} -> {{arrivalCode}} is sold as ONE itinerary stitched from two carriers.
             Dates are computed by the folder pre-request: today + daysToDeparture (return: today + daysToReturn). -->
        <cns:FlightRequest>
            <cns:FlightRequestOriginDestinationsCriteria>
                <cns:OriginDestCriteria>
                    <cns:DestArrivalCriteria>
                        <cns:Date>{{arrivalDate}}</cns:Date>
                        <cns:IATA_LocationCode>{{arrivalCode}}</cns:IATA_LocationCode>
                    </cns:DestArrivalCriteria>
                    <cns:OriginDepCriteria>
                        <cns:Date>{{departureDate}}</cns:Date>
                        <cns:IATA_LocationCode>{{departureCode}}</cns:IATA_LocationCode>
                    </cns:OriginDepCriteria>
                </cns:OriginDestCriteria>
            </cns:FlightRequestOriginDestinationsCriteria>
        </cns:FlightRequest>
        <cns:PaxList>
            <cns:Pax>
                <cns:PaxID>PAX1</cns:PaxID>
                <cns:PTC>ADT</cns:PTC>
            </cns:Pax>
            <cns:Pax>
                <cns:PaxID>PAX2</cns:PaxID>
                <cns:PTC>CHD</cns:PTC>
            </cns:Pax>
            <cns:Pax>
                <cns:PaxID>PAX3</cns:PaxID>
                <cns:PTC>INF</cns:PTC>
            </cns:Pax>
        </cns:PaxList>
    </Request>
</IATA_AirShoppingRQ>

item.description:
Pre-booking **seats** on a new booking: shop -> SeatAvailability by offer -> OfferPrice (flight + seats) -> OrderCreate [Pay Later] (flight + seats) -> pay by cash -> retrieve.

SeatAvailability asks for the seat map of the leg chosen by `ancillaryLeg` (default 1 = the AeroCRS leg); its test script seats every passenger except the infant, one free seat each outside `excludedSeatRows`, with the seat's own offer item for that passenger.

Expected: one SeatMap with free seats (0.00 EUR on dev); OfferPrice prices flight + seats (6 + 2 items); OrderCreate [Pay Later] returns 8 order items, the two seat items REQUESTED.

Known limits (dev, 2026-10-06): OrderChange [Pay] [CASH] on that order answers 200 **without** ticket numbers - the order stays OPEN, the seat items REQUESTED. Do not send the payment again. The seat map of the SMS leg (`ancillaryLeg` = 2) answers 422 / 911 `No OfferItemSegmentAttributes found for key ...`.

item.description:
Post-booking **service** (SSR) on an existing paid booking. The folder creates its own paid order first: shop -> price -> OrderCreate [Instant CASH Pay] -> ServiceList by order -> OrderQuote (service) -> OrderChange [ADD SERVICE] -> OrderChange [PAY] [CASH] -> retrieve.

ServiceList by order asks **in the currency of the order**; the test script picks one item for the adult by `serviceCode` (default XBAG).

Expected: OrderQuote shows the added item with the amount to pay; OrderChange [ADD SERVICE] returns the new service item(s) REQUESTED and the amount of the new purchase; OrderChange [Pay] [CASH] pays exactly that amount and the service item becomes CONFIRMED; OrderRetrieve shows the order total = flights + service.

Known limits (dev, 2026-10-06): asking ServiceList in another currency than the order leaves the order unreadable afterwards (`Bad Request - Currency mismatch: EUR/USD`) - this folder asks in the order currency. On one of two runs the order view after the payment was incomplete: OrderRetrieve returned only the two service items (PaxList with the adult only, ticket numbers without PaxRefID, total = service price), while the other run returned the whole order (flights + service, 879.90 EUR).

item.description:
Post-booking **seat** on an existing paid booking. The folder creates its own paid order first: shop -> price -> OrderCreate [Instant CASH Pay] -> SeatAvailability by order -> OrderQuote (seat) -> OrderChange [ADD SEAT] -> OrderChange [PAY] [CASH] -> retrieve.

Known limit (dev, 2026-10-06): SeatAvailability by order answers 422 / 911 `Unprocessable Entity - Can't find company code`; the seat steps that follow are skipped because no seat offer exists.

# UseCase - VI (Virtual Interline over NDC)

The same NDC 21.3.5 messages as the **UseCase** folder, adapted to a **Virtual Interline (VI)** sale: one itinerary stitched from two carriers on two different reservation systems, sold and paid as **one** NDC order. On the dev route **TLV -> LBV** leg 1 (TLV-POG) is flown by the AeroCRS carrier and leg 2 (POG-LBV) by the SMS carrier; the order comes back with one PNR and one ticket per carrier.

What is different on VI, and what these requests take care of:

- A VI offer carries **one offer item per passenger per leg** (OW: 6, RT: 12). OfferPrice and OrderCreate must select **all** of them with the PaxRefID the offer gives each item - the AirShopping / OfferPrice test scripts build that list (`{{shopSelectedOfferItemsXml_*}}`, `{{pricedSelectedOfferItemsXml_ns2}}`) so the bodies never hard-code item counts or passengers.
- Every id a step needs is read from the previous response and stored in the **environment**; nothing is hard-coded. If a variable is missing (an earlier step failed) the request is **not sent** and fails with a "precondition" test instead of hitting the server with a stale id.
- Payment is **cash (CA)** only. Debit-account payment is not supported on VI; card payment needs a PCI-Proxy token (see *Order Change -> payment* in the partner guide), so neither is included here.

## Preconditions

- Environment **NDC-VI** (`NDC-VI.postman_environment.json`): set `x-api-key` to your VI key - the key selects the tenant (`vindc-aero`) and the sales channel (`VI`). Optional inputs: `daysToDeparture` (default 2), `daysToReturn` (default 9), `myEmail`, `serviceCode` (default XBAG), `ancillaryLeg` (default 1), `excludedSeatRows` (default 1,2,3), `offerIndex` (default 0).
- Travel dates are computed when a request runs: departure = today + daysToDeparture, return = today + daysToReturn. Passengers: 1 ADT + 1 CHD + 1 INF.
- Run a use case **top to bottom** (Collection Runner or newman); the later requests of a use case depend on the earlier ones. *Retrieve booking* needs a create use case run first in the same session.

## Not included - not supported on VI as of 2026-10-06

- **Cancel booking** - OrderReshop (cancel) answers 404 / 911 `Not Found - No static resource reshop/cancel`.
- **Cancel segment** - OrderReshop is rejected before any reshop (a VI origin-destination has 6 items); partial cancel is not available.
- **Rebook** - OrderReshop (reshop) answers 422 / 911 `No reservation flight matches the journey segment for rebook search`.
- **Name change** - OrderReshop (passenger change) answers 404 / 911 `Not Found - No static resource reshop/passenger-changes`.

## Known limits in the included use cases (dev, 2026-10-06)

See the description of each use case folder. In short:

- Ancillaries by offer (ServiceList / SeatAvailability) are available for the AeroCRS leg (`ancillaryLeg` = 1). Asking for the SMS leg (`ancillaryLeg` = 2) or for both legs at once answers 422 / 911 `Unprocessable Entity - No segment attributes found for segment key: FlightSegmentEventKey{flightDesignator=W10113, ...}` (ServiceList) / `No OfferItemSegmentAttributes found for key FlightSegmentEventKey{...}` (SeatAvailability).
- Ancillary services must be requested in the currency of the flight offer / order (these requests do). Asking in another currency ends in `Currency mismatch: EUR/USD` at OfferPrice, OrderCreate or OrderRetrieve.
- Paying an order that carries **seats**: OrderChange [Pay] answers 200 **without** ticket numbers; the order stays OPEN with the seat items REQUESTED. Do not send the payment again.
- **SeatAvailability by order** answers 422 / 911 `Unprocessable Entity - Can't find company code`.
- After paying a service added to an existing order, OrderRetrieve sometimes returns only the service items (flights, passengers CHD/INF and ticket PaxRefIDs missing from the view).
- Dev inventory: a flight has a finite infant allotment. After several runs on the same date OrderCreate answers 422 / 911 `Failed to create reservation - 422 Number of INFT SSR is exhausted on this flight.` - change `daysToDeparture`.

const fmtDate = d => d.getFullYear() + '-' + pad(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + pad(d.getDate());
return fmtDate(d) + 'T' + pad(d.getHours()) + ':' + pad(d.getMinutes()) + ':' + pad(d.getSeconds()) + '.' + pad(d.getMilliseconds(), 3) + s + pad(Math.floor(a / 60)) + ':' + pad(a % 60);
const addDays = n => { const d = new Date(now); d.setDate(d.getDate() + n); return d; };
const shift = (years, months) => { const d = new Date(now); d.setFullYear(d.getFullYear() + years); d.setMonth(d.getMonth() + months); return d; };
const missing = used.filter(n => { const v = pm.variables.get(n); return v === undefined || v === null || String(v) === ''; });
pm.test('precondition: every {{variable}} used by this request is set', () => {
pm.expect.fail('Request NOT sent - unresolved variable(s): ' + missing.join(', ') + '. An earlier step of this use case failed, or run a create use case first.');
// ---- UseCase - VI : shared tests (run after every request of this folder) ----
